name: timing-cadence

steps.why: ~14 disk ticks at 5s plus TWO periodic uploads (t+5.7 and t+65.7) - 60s is the minimum window that proves the upload cadence rather than assuming it
forced flush, then the re-anchored disk flush at +5s; proves the periodic schedule reset

description: Establishes both cadences and the post-flush reset in one capture. 70s of foreground gives ~14 disk ticks at 5s and two periodic uploads 60s apart; the backgrounding then shows the schedule re-anchor on the forced flush.
